text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just to realize a loss and then buy it back at a higher price; decisions should reflect its current prospects and my plan, not my average cost.","A few months of gains or losses are not enough reason to make abrupt trades. I should review the portfolio consistently and avoid reacting to short-term swings.","My account has fallen from its earlier value, so I should manage risk and keep my apartment goal in view: diversify, preserve suitable cash, and invest with a time horizon I can tolerate."]}
